title: dhammaniyāmatā
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en: “Therein, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple attends closely and carefully to dependent origination itself thus:

tatra.label: indeclinable
tatra.dpd: in that case; in that regard; in this matter; in this connection

heads.meaning: in that case; in that regard; in this matter; in this connection

bhikkhave.label: masculine noun · vocative plural
bhikkhave.dpd: monk; monastic; mendicant; fully ordained monk
bhikkhave.note: bhikkhave and bhikkhavo are two vocative plural forms of bhikkhu.

heads.meaning: monk; monastic; mendicant; fully ordained monk

ariya-sāvako.label: masculine noun · nominative singular
ariya-sāvako.dpd: a disciple of the noble ones; a noble disciple

heads.meaning: a disciple of the noble ones; a noble disciple

paṭicca-samuppādaṃyeva.label: two words joined (sandhi)
paṭicca-samuppādaṃyeva.ctx: arising together from a cause just
paṭicca-samuppādaṃyeva.note: eva (“just, only”) is joined to the word before it.

parts.label: masculine noun · accusative singular of paṭiccasamuppāda

yoniso.label: indeclinable
yoniso.note: yoniso manasi-kāra: attention that goes to the source, “wise attention”.

manasi.label: masculine noun · locative singular
manasi.note: manasi karotha, “put it in the mind”: attend closely.
manasi.decl:

iti.label: indeclinable
iti.dpd: thus; like this; this is; and so

heads.meaning: thus; like this; this is; and so

sati.label: feminine noun · nominative singular
sati.dpd: memory; remembering; recollection; keeping in mind

heads.meaning: memory; remembering; recollection; keeping in mind

imass’uppādā.label: two words joined (sandhi)
imass’uppādā.dpd: from the arising of this; when this arises
imass’uppādā.note: Two words joined: the apostrophe marks the sound lost where they meet (imassa + uppādā).

uppajjati.label: verb · present, 3rd person singular
uppajjati.dpd: appears; arises; occurs; takes place (for or in)

heads.meaning: appears; arises; occurs; takes place (for or in)

asati.note: asati = a + sati (locative of santa), “when … is not”.
